title: No bulk consent; the setting stands if enrolment is cancelled
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. A customer whose notification setting you will change from inside enrolment, and a unit whose enrolling customer you will unlink.
custom_steps:
1. Look for any bulk consent action anywhere.
  2. Change the setting inside enrolment, then cancel the enrolment; re-check the setting.
  3. Unlink the enrolling customer from a unit and check tracking.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • There is no bulk consent action anywhere - the setting is on by default, so there is nothing to turn on in bulk.
  • A setting changed from inside enrolment stands even if the enrolment is then cancelled (enrolling a unit and notifying a customer are separate acts).
  • A unit whose enrolling customer is unlinked from it stops being tracked for that customer; enrolling it again for another customer follows that customer's setting from then on.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S7-E6: “A unit whose enrolling customer is unlinked from it stops being tracked for that customer. Enrolling it again for another customer follows that customer's setting from then on”
